terminals.name: api
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd api && uv run flask run --host 0.0.0.0 --port=5001 --debug

terminals.name: worker
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd api && uv run celery -A app.celery worker -P gevent -c 1 --loglevel INFO -Q dataset,generation,mail,ops_trace,app_deletion
terminals.description: Dify Celery worker for async tasks (dataset indexing, generation, mail, etc.)
